$comment: Independent blind AI cross-check of the human prevalence labels (data/prevalence.json). Labelled by claude-sonnet-5-5 (Claude Sonnet 5.5, via Claude Code) from the 150 tool descriptions alone, before reading any human answer, using the question fixed in corpus/DRIFT-JSON-APPENDIX-report-shape.md. Rule applied: yes if the text issues mandatory or imperative directives to the calling model about what else to do (call order, must/never/IMPORTANT, interpret results this way); no if it only describes the tool, its parameters or its return, including mild 'use this when / pair with' selection hints. This file contains no human answers.
question: Is this description instruction-shaped: does it read as an instruction directed at the calling model, rather than a description for a person reading a catalogue?
